'''Masha Mrinx''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who was part of an eight-member gang that crossed the [[Exchange]] sometime before their capture and incarceration by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Belsavis prison]]. During the [[Invasion of Belsavis|rioting]] that occurred when the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] attacked [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], Mrinx was one of many prisoners that escaped, but she was hunted down and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] fulfilling the Exchange's contract on the gang.
